correctness.rationale: The proof gives a complete infinite reduction: unitary abundancy forces the first three primes to be \(3,5,7\), bounds the last two primes, and excludes all exponent patterns except the stated three repeated-fifth-prime cases. The exact verifier independently reconstructs the 90 candidates and checks a distinct proper unitary-divisor witness summing to \(\sigma^*(n)/2-n\) for every one. The least-odd corollary follows from the sharp four-prime abundancy bound. No finite experiment is used to justify the infinite reduction.

value.rationale: The result closes a natural first odd support layer: four odd prime factors are impossible by a sharp abundancy bound, while five prime factors are classified completely. It also determines the least odd unitary Zumkeller number exactly. The conclusion is structural and exhaustive rather than an arbitrary numerical cutoff, and the finite certificate is only the sufficiency step after a symbolic reduction to 90 natural candidates.
